prompt: A wide interior view of a modern private dental surgery room, seen from the doorway. An implant surgeon in a dark navy scrub gown and loupes works over a patient whose face is out of frame, an assistant beside them; both are absorbed in the work and neither looks at the camera. A surgical unit, physiodispenser and instrument tray in the foreground, a large monitor on the wall showing a CBCT cross-section. Concrete wall, pale oak cabinetry. Documentary editorial photograph for a private dental clinic website. Cool northern daylight from a large window, calm muted palette of blue-grey, warm concrete, pale oak and stainless steel, matching a #E4E9EC paper tone. Shot on 35mm, natural shallow depth of field, honest and unposed. STRICTLY AVOID: stock-photo smiling faces looking at camera, thumbs up, bright teal or mint medical cliche colours, glossy over-retouched skin, sparkling white cartoon teeth, close-up of an open mouth, blood, anything gruesome. Photographic realism, no illustration, no 3D render, no text overlay.
